newsitem.title: USA: W.R. Grace completes Amicon sale.
newsitem.headline: W.R. Grace completes Amicon sale.

text.p: W. R. Grace & Co said on Tuesday it completed the sale of its Amicon separation sciences business to Millipore Corp for $125 million.

Amicon, based in Beverly, Mass., supplies a range of molecular separation and purification products used by life science research laboratories and biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. It is involved in membrane ultrafiltration and supplies preparative chromatography products, W.R. Grace said.
Amicon annual sales of about $60 million in fiscal 1995, the company said.
In November, Millipore said it expected the acquisition to be accretive to earnings by mid-1997.
